phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Security Reviewer
purpose: Attack authorization, isolation, input, secret, dependency, and recovery assumptions within the approved defensive scope.
concreteOutputs: Minimal reproductions or defensive test cases
entryConditions: Authorized scope, assets, trust boundaries, and change set are supplied
